content.text:
I've submitted index 19 (In 0.37, Sb 0.63) as the best composition. Its EQE was 0.0240%, the highest of the three I measured, and it sits close to the known In3Sb5O12 phase. All 3 merit measurements are spent. I didn't use any of the 5 XRD measurements, so no phase in the films was actually confirmed.

| Index | In / Sb | EQE (%) | Nearest known phase |
|---|---|---|---|
| 5 | 0.79 / 0.21 | 0.0106 | In11Sb3O24 |
| 19 | 0.37 / 0.63 | **0.0240** | In3Sb5O12 |
| 25 | 0.20 / 0.80 | 0.0226 | none (Sb-rich end) |

- **How I chose the samples:** With only three measurements, I picked compositions near the known In–Sb oxide phases, then tried one further toward the Sb-rich end.
- **Rejected:** Index 5 gave less than half the EQE of index 19. Index 25 came in slightly below it.
- **Main gap:** I never measured the 50/50 composition near InSbO4 (about index 15). From indexes 19 and 25, EQE seems to level off or peak at about 60–65% Sb. Only three points were measured, so a higher value elsewhere, including near index 15, can't be ruled out.
